name.en: Worst One versus Raikiri Final Selection Battle

periods.summary: Ikki and Toka meet in the final selection battle. Ikki refuses to evade Raikiri and opens with Ittou Shura, while Toka honors him by answering with her strongest Raikiri. In the instant of collision Ikki compresses all of Ittou Shura into one strike, Ittou Rasetsu, shattering Narukami and defeating Toka.
periods.cause: Akaza forces the duel as the condition for Ikki's future, but both Ikki and Toka choose to fight as proud knights.
periods.process: Toka considers dodging but rejects that dishonor; Ikki charges directly with Seventh Secret Sword Raikou. Raikiri is initially faster, so Ikki abandons all other bodily functions and concentrates his full capacity into a single instant. His evolved strike breaks Toka's Device and knocks her unconscious.
periods.outcome: Ikki wins the final match, secures a representative slot, and public opinion witnesses him defeat Hagun's strongest student. Toka accepts defeat and resolves to grow stronger.
periods.aftermath: Ikki receives the new title Another One / Uncrowned Sword King. Akaza's scheme collapses, and Ikki soon collapses from backlash and illness.
periods.significance: Climax of the school arc; proves Ikki's strength, exposes the futility of the Kurogane scheme, and creates the Ittou Rasetsu technique.
